limits: Every normalized zero is an explicit source-table zero, not a filled gap. Em-dash CTR/position remain null.
Complete ninety-date coverage and correct filter/tab/raw-row/pagination evidence are required for acceptance.
Query-only daily series and exact-page daily series retain different aggregation; they are not summed together.
Weighted positions from rounded daily displays are approximate; CTR is recalculated from additive counts.
Prior7/prior28 derived periods are available within90days at identical source grain; prior90days unavailable.
All data ends beforeOctober26deployments and cannot measure their recovery effect.
